model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different models. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. 

The black line, representing "Base", begins at approximately 64% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1, and rises to approximately 72% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1000, with a slight curve. The brown line, representing "MEND", starts at about 71% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1, and increases to about 74% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1000, displaying a generally flat trajectory. The blue line, labeled "FT", originates at roughly 66% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1, and increases to around 71% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1000, showing a consistent but moderate upward trend. The purple line, representing "MEMIT", begins at approximately 72% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1, and rises to around 76% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1000, revealing a gradual increase. The red line, labeled "IKE", starts at approximately 68% when the Co-occurrence Number is 1, declines to a minimum of about 67% at a Co-occurrence Number of 10, then rises to approximately 70% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1000. Finally, the green line, representing "ROME", begins at approximately 74% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1, and increases steadily to roughly 79% at a Co-occurrence Number of 1000, displaying the steepest positive slope.
